obligations.summary: The Commission shall ensure that appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies active in conformity assessment procedures for high-risk AI systems are put in place and properly operated in the form of a sectoral group of notified bodies.
Each notifying authority shall ensure that the notified bodies it has notified participate in the work of the sectoral group of notified bodies, directly or through designated representatives.
The Commission shall provide for the exchange of knowledge and best practices between notifying authorities.
